name: frontend
description: Front-end fixes on the element Daniel selected, and a look at the page Daniel is on: the pinned Chrome DevTools MCP server attached to the Agent Chrome, seeing its localhost pages only, ui-capture, which writes a capture of the localhost page Daniel is on (its URL, route, Vue route, screenshot, accessibility snapshot, console problems and failed requests) into a directory, with the selected element's HTML, matched CSS, Vue source location and screenshot when one is selected, and the skill that fixes it from there. For Daniel's own Claude Code session and the coordinator's intake; build workers read captures, never the Agent Chrome.
